quotes.text: "You've heard of him?" "No." "Why, young fellah, where have you lived? Sir John Ballinger is the best gentleman jock in the north country."
quotes.reference: 1912, Arthur Conan Doyle, The Lost World […], London; New York, N.Y.: Hodder and Stoughton, →OCLC:

senses.definition: An athletic supporter worn by men to support the genitals especially during sports.
(US, slang) A young male athlete, typically tall and aged 16–23.
(US, slang, derogatory) An enthusiastic sports fan, especially one with few other interests, often stereotyped as slow-witted person of large size and great physical strength.

quotes.text: 'Cause all jocks ever think about is sports, all we ever think about is sex.

examples: There was never a single listener protest or objection — the entire opposition to the content of the program came from a few jocks within the station.

quotes.text: As a teenager, I laid down the sword and decided I wanted to be a disc jockey. […] I'd sit outside the studio and watch with envy and admiration as the jocks performed in the small room on the other side of the soundproof window […]
